name: How do foreign nationals typically finance a condo purchase in areas like Miami or Fort Lauderdale?

mainEntity.name: How do foreign nationals typically finance a condo purchase in areas like Miami or Fort Lauderdale?

acceptedAnswer.text: Foreign nationals often use cash or secure a mortgage from a U.S. lender. While cash purchases simplify the transaction, many prefer financing. Lenders specializing in foreign national loans are available, though they usually require a higher down payment, sometimes 30-40% or more, and a strong financial history. Discussing your specific financial situation with a knowledgeable real estate agent can help identify suitable lending options.
acceptedAnswer.description: Financing typically involves cash or a U.S. mortgage, often requiring a higher down payment for foreign nationals.
